$comment: Expected GitHub repository configuration, asserted in CI by
.github/scripts/check_config_drift.py. This file is the source of truth:
if the live repo diverges from it, the config-drift workflow fails.
This exists because a control described only in prose is indistinguishable
from one that does not exist. On 2026-07-20 both ARCHITECTURE.md and
docs/git-and-deploy-workflow.md claimed a required-reviewer gate on prod
deploys while the `production` environment had no protection rules at all,
and nothing noticed for as long as the config existed. This job is the
thing that would have noticed. See docs/delivery-workflow-architecture.md.
To CHANGE the real config: change it on GitHub AND update this file in the
same PR. The checker asserts only the keys declared here; it ignores repo
settings and environments this file does not mention (e.g. the Vercel-
managed Preview/Production environments), so it never fights integrations.

production.$comment: Deliberately UNPROTECTED. Code-only deploys ship unattended; the human gate is on migrations only. Do not add required_reviewers here — add it via production-migrations.

production-migrations.$comment: The real gate. A deploy touching backend/migrations/versions/ routes here (see deploy-prod.yml detect-migrations).
